paragraphs.text: Ishkanah , also known as the Broodmother or Grafwidow , is a spider of Innistrad .

Ishkanah is a monstrous Spider that became even more horrific after the arrival of Emrakul , though it appears to have not been conscripted or controlled. Instead as werewolves , vampires , and humans contend for power, Ishkanah builds her army of spiders in the shadows.
